title: I asked AI for a room with NO elephant 🐘

beats.big:
A room with
NO elephant.
Easy, right?
beats.say: I asked AI to draw a room with no elephant in it.

beats.sub: there is an elephant in it
beats.say: Here's your room. There is an elephant in it.
Okay. A man without a beard. He has a beard.
Researchers in Seoul called this the pink elephant paradox. They found it in Stable Diffusion and DALL-E 3.

beats.sub: you just did. so does the AI.
beats.say: Don't think of a pink elephant. You just did. And so does the AI.
Adding the word not doesn't erase elephant. The model still hears elephant, loud and clear.
The fix? Describe what you want instead. Ask for an empty room.
